text: In 1843 the government investigator Alfredo Ortiz comes to Araba searching for gold lost in the First Carlist War and for Patxi, a blacksmith whose ruined forge in the woods the villagers avoid. Usue, an orphan girl with a burn-scarred face, slips inside after her doll and finds [a boy in an iron cage|images|ropes, cages and executions] who begs her to steal Patxi's keys. The boy is [the demon Sartael|threat|the devil and dark gods], bound to Patxi by [a deal made during the war|origin|bargains with dark powers] and kept at bay with [spilled chickpeas and blessed golden bells|rules|faith and charms protect].
